punchline: Navarro calls the steeple of fingertips one of the strongest confidence signals.
thirty_sec: Joe Navarro says confident people take up more room and steeple their fingertips, and he suggests spreading items outward on a desk. Fingers hanging out of pockets read as low confidence, and hands on hips as authority. None of it is proof on its own, since you read a person against their own normal. But your own posture is yours to choose.
